name: House Enforcer
desc: Gilded Wheel security, with more money in their arms than you have in your ship.

intro: A very well-dressed person with very expensive arms asks you to step away from the table, and cracks each finger individually.
House security arrives without any fuss. One of them takes off a dinner jacket, folds it, and looks at you.
hit: A gilded fist hits you with a piston's thump, and you can hear the servos working.
They catch your wrist, turn it the way it doesn't go, and apologize on behalf of the House.
An arm extends further than any arm should, and collects you from across the table.
miss: The fist punches through the card table beside you, and chips rain down around your feet.
You slip under the swing, and the enforcer straightens a cuff as if that was the plan.
You duck, and the blow takes a chunk out of the gilded pillar behind you. Somebody makes a note of it, and of you.
crit: The arm hits you, then a second charge fires inside it, and the second hit is the one you feel.
defeated: The augments whine down, and the enforcer tells you, quite politely, that the House will add this to your bill.
The enforcer drops, and a small gold light on their wrist starts blinking, calling someone on your behalf.
joins: {Enemy} appears at your elbow without seeming to have crossed the room.
stunned: {Enemy} stops dead and resets their stance, servos ticking, while you catch your breath.
